Programming Language Reference: Swift
Version: Swift 5.10 / Swift 6
Syntax: Safe, fast, and modern systems language developed by Apple with type inference and protocol-oriented programming.
Semantics: Compiled to native code via LLVM, Automatic Reference Counting (ARC), data race safety in Swift 6.
Type System: Static strong typing with Optionals (Type?), value-type preference (structs/enums), Protocol-oriented design.
Memory Model: Automatic Reference Counting (ARC) with weak and unowned references to prevent retain cycles.
Concurrency: Async/await, Actors (isolate mutable state), Task groups, Sendable protocol for thread-safe data transfer.
Error Handling: throws / try / catch pattern, Result enum.
Standard APIs: Swift Standard Library, Foundation, Combine, Dispatch (GCD)
Specification: The Swift Programming Language (https://swift.org/documentation/)
Official Docs: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/swift
